name: Worlds Hardest Game 2
description: The second episode of the self-proclaimed world's hardest game series! Hone your reflexes and accuracy as you try to move your little block to the end of each stage without touching the obstacles.

name: YoHoHo.io
description: Ahoy, matey! Ye have been marooned on a tropical island with other pirates... Only one will survive and plunder the booty. Give no quarter!
controls:
To move, use your mouse or press WASD/arrow keys
To attack, press left mouse button or space bar. Hold to charge an attack

name: Zombs Royale
description: 100 player 2D real-time massive multiplayer Battle Royale game in your browser, inspired by PUBG/Fortnite.
controls:
[WASD] or [Arrow Keys] - move
[Click] - attack

name: Mathway
description: Mathway is an online platform and mobile app that provides step-by-step solutions to a wide range of mathematical problems. The website and app cater to various levels of math, from basic arithmetic to advanced calculus.

name: Online Games
description: OnlineGames.io is a website that offers a collection of free online games. Users can play a variety of games directly in their web browsers without needing to download any software. The site features a range of game genres, including action, puzzle, strategy, sports, and more.

name: Science
description: Discover endless entertainment with Science Unblocked – your top choice for unblocked games accessible from school or work.

name: Premium Games
description: Explore our diverse library on Classroom Games, featuring a wide range of fun and nonviolent games. Our selection includes puzzles, strategy games, skill challenges, sports, and more. Every player can find a game that matches their tastes and preferences.

name: GeForce Now
description: GeForce Now is a cloud gaming service developed by NVIDIA. It allows users to play video games on various devices without the need for high-end hardware. Instead of running games locally on a gaming PC or console, GeForce Now streams the games from powerful remote servers to your device over the internet.

name: Fortnite
description: Fortnite is a popular online video game developed by Epic Games, first released in 2017. It is available in three distinct game modes that share the same general gameplay and game engine: (1) Save the World: This is a cooperative hybrid tower defense-shooter-survival game where up to four players fight off zombie-like creatures and defend objects using traps and fortifications they can build. It was the original mode released and is available for purchase. (2) Fortnite Battle Royale: This is a free-to-play battle royale game where up to 100 players fight to be the last person standing. Players can either play solo, in a duo, or in squads of up to four players. The game includes various weapons, items, and materials that players can collect and use to defeat opponents and build structures for defense or mobility. (3) Fortnite Creative: In this mode, players are given complete freedom to create worlds and battle arenas. It's a sandbox mode where creativity is key, and players can design their own games and share them with others.

name: Google
description: The Google Search website is accessible at www.google.com. This is the main page for Google's search engine, where users can enter queries to search the web for information, images, news, videos, and more.

name: Youtube
description: YouTube is a global online video-sharing and social media platform where users can upload, view, share, and comment on videos. It hosts a wide variety of content, including music videos, educational videos, vlogs, live streams, short films, documentaries, and much more. Users can also subscribe to channels, create playlists, and interact with other users through comments and likes.

name: Discord
description: Discord is a free communication platform that allows users to create communities.
